mapper.sql: select l.log_id, l.log_code, l.courtyard_id, c.courtyard_name, l.address_id, l.address_name, l.detail_address, l.main_type, l.sub_type, l.inspect_result, l.hazard_level, l.description, l.tenant_name, l.tenant_phone, l.inspect_time, coalesce(u.nick_name, l.create_by) as worker_name, l.create_by, l.create_time, l.update_by, l.update_time, l.remark from ins_log l left join ins_courtyard c on l.courtyard_id = c.courtyard_id left join sys_user u on l.create_by = u.user_name and u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select max(l.log_id) as log_id, l.address_id, max(a.address_name) as address_name, l.detail_address, max(l.courtyard_id) as courtyard_id, max(c.courtyard_name) as courtyard_name, max(l.sub_type) as sub_type, l.tenant_name, l.tenant_phone, max(l.inspect_time) as inspect_time, max(l.inspect_result) as inspect_result, max(l.hazard_level) as hazard_level from ins_log l left join ins_address a on l.address_id = a.address_id left join ins_courtyard c on l.courtyard_id = c.courtyard_id where l.tenant_name is not null and l.tenant_name != '' and l.courtyard_id = #{courtyardId} and l.courtyard_id in (${courtyardIds}) and l.sub_type = #{subType} and l.tenant_name like concat('%', #{tenantName}, '%') and l.tenant_phone like concat('%', #{tenantPhone}, '%') group by l.address_id, l.tenant_name, l.tenant_phone, l.detail_address order by max(l.inspect_time) desc
mapper.insert: insert into ins_log(log_code, courtyard_id, address_id, address_name, detail_address, main_type, sub_type, inspect_result, hazard_level, description, tenant_name, tenant_phone, inspect_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values(#{logCode}, #{courtyardId}, #{addressId}, #{addressName}, #{detailAddress}, #{mainType}, #{subType}, #{inspectResult}, #{hazardLevel}, #{description}, #{tenantName}, #{tenantPhone}, #{inspectTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.select: where l.address_id = #{addressId} order by l.inspect_time desc limit 1

select max(l.log_id) as log_id, l.tenant_name, l.tenant_phone, l.detail_address from ins_log l where l.address_id = #{addressId} and l.tenant_name is not null and l.tenant_name != '' and l.sub_type = #{subType} group by l.tenant_name, l.tenant_phone, l.detail_address order by max(l.inspect_time) desc
